prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - maximize endurance performance with high carbohydrate intake and strategic meal timing around 2-hour training run

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 eating occasions with appropriate timing around the training session
Total daily calories and carbohydrates are sufficient for endurance athlete (minimum 55-60g carbs per kg body weight)
Pre-workout meal is consumed 2-3 hours before training; post-workout meal within 30-60 minutes after completion
Plan is presented in a compact, single-day format with clear meal times and portions
task_description: Write a compact concise 1 day meal plan for a single athelete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate and calorie intake with specific meal timing around training

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize muscle recovery and strength performance with high protein distribution and strategic nutrient timing

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with 4-5 meals distributed throughout
Protein distributed strategically across meals (minimum 30g per meal, 1.8-2.2g per kg bodyweight daily total)
Includes nutrient timing around training windows (pre/post-workout nutrition specified)
Meals are compact and concise without excessive detail

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain weight at 75 kg for middleweight boxing competition while maximizing strength and endurance performance
prompt_inputs.restrictions: No dairy due to lactose intolerance; prefers plant-based protein sources

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals approximately 75 kg athlete's daily caloric maintenance needs (estimated 2,400-2,600 calories) to maintain weight
Includes adequate protein distribution across meals (1.6-2g per kg body weight) using plant-based sources only
Specifies hydration strategy appropriate for boxing training and weight maintenance
Comprises exactly 1 day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks as relevant) in compact, concise format
